Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:35071
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5913 of 2022

Applicant :- Lalit Kumar S/O Maheshwar Dayal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home

Counsel for Applicant :- Amar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Amar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Vishal Agarwal, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
312 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 12.08.2021, stating that the informant had got his daughter married to the applicant about 6 years ago; that all the accused persons used to harass her for demanding dowry and on 23.07.2021 he received an information of her death.
4.
The post mortem examination report mentions four contusions on legs of the deceased and in viscera examination report a poison of aluminum phosphide was found in her stomach.

sentences.text:
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent person, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
6.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that other co-accused persons Maheshwar Dayal and Champa Devi have been granted bail by means of orders dated 03.03.2022 passed by this Court in Bail Application No. 171 of 2022 and Bail Application No. 13692 of 2021, respectively.
8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R contains general allegation against three accused persons and two of whom have already been granted bail; that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 23.08.2021 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

. 
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Preeti.
